##### Project general facts

Damac Towers by Paramount is an iconic mixed-use residential and hospitality development located in Dubai’s prestigious Burj area. The project consists of four striking towers rising approximately 270 metres above the city, with three towers dedicated to luxury residences and the fourth housing the Paramount Hotel. Inspired by the glamour of Hollywood, the development combines sophisticated architecture with cinematic design influences, offering a distinctive lifestyle experience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations near Downtown Dubai and the city’s major attractions.

The development features an extensive collection of premium amenities designed to reflect the luxury hospitality standards of the Paramount brand. A multi-level plaza connects all four towers and includes specialty restaurants, a dine-in cinema, wellness facilities, swimming pools, and a dedicated Kids Studio Club. Residents also benefit from access to the world-class facilities of the Paramount Hotel, creating an environment that blends residential comfort with five-star hotel services and entertainment-focused experiences.

The interiors are designed with exceptional attention to detail, combining elegant architectural finishes, thoughtfully planned layouts, and luxurious design elements inspired by the glamour of the film industry. Kitchens are fully equipped with modern appliances, while all residences are delivered fully furnished, creating a turnkey living experience that reflects the sophistication, comfort, and cinematic character of the Paramount brand.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
